direct_messages.title.description: Heading and document title of the page of the user's direct messages by conversation, and its item in the main navigation. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in the side rail of tablets and in the menu sheet of phones.

direct_messages.nav_unread.description: Accessible name of the navigation item of the direct messages while some conversations are unread. Start it with the text of direct_messages.title, which is shown. {count} is the number of unread conversations.

direct_messages.unread_count.description: The number of unread conversations on the badge of the navigation item of the direct messages, for example '3 unread'.

direct_messages.unread.description: Read by screen readers before the names of a conversation in which a post of another account is unread.

direct_messages.participants.self.description: Names of a conversation in which the user wrote only to themselves, in place of the names of the other people.

direct_messages.participants.more.description: Names of a conversation with more than three other people. {names} is a list of the first three names, {count} how many more people there are.

direct_messages.content_warning.description: Excerpt of the newest post of a conversation when that post has a content warning: only the warning is shown. {summary} is the warning, written by the author.

direct_messages.open.description: Excerpt of the newest post of a conversation when that post has no text (pictures only): a link to the conversation's thread.

direct_messages.empty.defaultMessage: まだ DM はありません
direct_messages.empty.description: Heading of the empty state of the direct messages.

direct_messages.empty.description.defaultMessage: メンションした人だけが見られる投稿が、会話ごとにここに集まります。送るには、投稿の公開範囲で「メンションした人」を選ぶか、相手の投稿のメニューで「ダイレクトメッセージ」を選びます。
direct_messages.empty.description.description: Description of the empty state of the direct messages: what the page shows and how to write a direct message. “Mentioned people” is compose.visibility.direct.

direct_messages.failed.defaultMessage: DM を読み込めませんでした
direct_messages.failed.description: Heading of the failure of the direct messages in place of the list.

direct_messages.retry.description: Button that loads the direct messages again after a failure.

direct_messages.load_more.defaultMessage: さらに会話を読み込む
direct_messages.load_more.description: Button at the end of the direct messages that loads older conversations.

direct_messages.loading.defaultMessage: DM を読み込んでいます
direct_messages.loading.description: Read by screen readers while the direct messages load.

direct_messages.signed_out.heading.defaultMessage: ログインしていません
direct_messages.signed_out.heading.description: Heading of the direct messages page for a visitor who is not signed in.

direct_messages.signed_out.defaultMessage: DM を見るにはログインしてください。
direct_messages.signed_out.description: Description of the direct messages page for a visitor who is not signed in.
